dhī/:'chi med mtsho skyes snying tig las:rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs sgyu 'phrul drwa ba bzhugs so::'chi med rtsa gsum lha la 'dud:ma 'ongs skal ldan skyes ba

tei:div.tei:p: dhī/: 'chi med mtsho skyes snying tig las: rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs sgyu 'phrul drwa ba bzhugs so: :

'chi med rtsa gsum lha la 'dud: ma 'ongs skal ldan skyes bu rnams: pad+ma bdag la skyabs gsol nas: dngos grub rnam gnyis don gnyer na: dbang thob dam tshig la gnas pas: dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas mchog tu: yar mar tshes bcu'i dus kyi tshe: sku gsung thugs kyi snang brnyan mdun: phyi nang mchod tshogs bzang du bsham: nges 'byung drag pos rgyud bskul te: sngon dngos rjes kyi rnal 'byor gyis: zab mo'i lam 'dir 'jug par bya: sa ma ya: sngon 'gro'i dang po skyabs 'gro ni: na mo: bdag sogs 'gro kun byang chub bar: dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum gyi dngos: rang rig mtsho skyes rdo rje la: 'du 'bral med par skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa smon 'jug sems bskyed ni: hoḥ gzhan don sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir: rim gnyis rnal 'byor nyams blangs nas: srid zhir mi gnas 'od gsal dbyings: khams gsum bsgral bar sems bskyed do: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa ni: hoḥ 'chi med rtsa gsum lha tshogs la: mi phyed gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sdig sgrib nyes ltung mthol zhing bshags: byang chub spyod la rjes yi rang : chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: dge tshogs chos dbyings snying por bsngo: bzhi pa sngon gtor sbyin pa ni: hūm̐: kun brtags 'khrul pa'i gdon bgegs tshogs: gzhan dbang dag pa rab 'byams kyi: 'dod yon gtor ma 'di longs la: yongs grub gnyug ma'i dbyings su dengs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: lnga pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hrīḥ bdag nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas: 'phros pa'i 'od kyis phyogs mtshams kun: gzung 'dzin mtshan mas mi phyed pa'i: rdo rje'i srung 'khor lhun gyis grub: oṃ badz+ra dzñā na rak+ṣa hūm̐ bhūm̐: drug pa ye shes byin 'bebs ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ dbyings rig zung 'jug pho brang nas: 'chi med rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyis: gnas 'dir dbang skur byin chen phob:

mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī sarba sa ma ya ā be sha ya a āḥ hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdun pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnas yul bde chen pad+mo bkod: dag pa rab 'byams zhing gi dbus: phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dod yon kun: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por rdzogs: oṃ sarba pū dza āḥhūm̐: sa ma ya: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa la: dang po bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor las: dam tshig 'khor lo bskyed pa ni: aḥ gzhi dbyings ka dag de bzhin nyid: sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la: gzhi snang lhun grub snying rje'i rtsal: sku dang zhing khams rang shar ba'i: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: sin+dhu rgya mtsho rol pa'i gling : shin tu nyams dga' ngo mtshar gyi: bkod pa du mas mdzes pa'i gzhir: yan lag brgyad ldan chu gter dbus: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: thabs shes nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng : so sor rtog pa'i rig mdangs rtsal: rang sems hrīḥyig dmar po las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas mchod: 'gro kun sgrib sbyangs snod dang bcud: 'og min pad+mo bkod pa'i zhing : mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor rdzogs: tshur 'dus rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i: lte bar hrīḥyis mtshan par gyur: de las skad cig dran rdzogs su: bdag nyid 'chi med mtsho skyes rje: rig 'dzin bla ma kun gyi dngos: zhal gcig phyag gnyis dkar dmar mdangs: zhi 'dzum gzhon tshul mtshan dper ldan: phyag g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas: gser gyi rdo rje thugs kar gtod: g.yon pas mnyam gzhag ka pā la: 'chi med bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams: rang 'od bde ster gsang ba'i yum: gri gug thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud: dar dang rin chen ut+pal brgyan: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: thugs kar pad+ma zla ba'i dbus: ye shes sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs: dbang mdog zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa:

thal sbyar phreng ba pad+ma bsnams: spyi bor pad nyi bam ro'i steng : yi dam yongs 'dus rta mchog dpal: dmar smug gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan: dpal dang dur khrod chas kun rdzogs: sbyor yum 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i gtso: phag mo mthing nag dgyes par rol: spyi gtsug rta gdong phag zhal bzhad: phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag bsnams: zhabs zung gyad kyi dor stabs kyis: ye shes me dpung dbus na 'gyings: de yi spyi bor pad zla'i steng : rigs kyi bdag po snang mtha' yas: dmar gsal mnyam gzhag lhung bzed 'dzin: sprul sku'i cha lugs mtshan dpes mdzes: steng phyogs 'ja' zer thig le'i klong : rtsa brgyud bla ma rig 'dzin dang : yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams lha: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyis: ye shes bdud rtsis dbang bskur zhing : me tog char 'bebs rol mo sgrogs: shis brjod rdo rje'i dbyangs su len: bar mtshams dpa' bo rnal 'byor mas: phyi nang mchod pa sprin ltar gtibs: mtha' skor rgyud gsum dregs pa'i sde: bka' nyan bran g.yog tshul du 'khod: kun kyang snang stong zung 'jug ngang : gtso bo gsum gyi gnas gsum du: rdo rje gsum gyi yi ges mtshan: de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis: ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs gyur: de nas ye shes spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐: sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phobs la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa yi:

ye shes lha tshogs gnas gsum nas: gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs kun: lha sngags phyag mtshan 'od zer gyi: rnam par byon te rang la thim: sgrib bzhi dag cing dbang bzhis smin: sku bzhi'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag: mchog thun dngos grub thob par bsam: gsol 'debs rdo rje'i tshig bdun dang : bsnyen pa'i sngags 'di spel la bzla: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: sa ma ya: gnyis pa sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ kā la wā ka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: dam tshig ye shes dbyer med pa'i: lha snang gsal zhing brtan pa la: rang las sprul pa'i lha mo yis: phyag 'tshal mchod cing bstod par bsam: hoḥ gdod nas rang rig rtsa gsum lha: 'du 'bral med par ro gcig kyang : gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa sbyang ba'i phyir: gus pa'i brda yis phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū hoḥ pra tits+tsha hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i mchod rdzas rigs: kun bzang mchod sprin cher spel nas: 'chi med rtsa gsum lha tshogs mchod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pād+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe ni wid+ya shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: yul dang dbang po mnyam sbyor ba'i: bde chen rdo rje'i dam tshig mchog: 'dod yon rnam pa thams cad pas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pra tits+tsha swā hā: oṃ: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar a mṛ ta: khams gsum bsgral ba'i rak+ta dang : 'dod yon lnga ldan ba liṃ tas: 'chi med rtsa gsum lha tshogs mchod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī sa pa rī wā ra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta pū dza ho: ā: dga' bzhi dbu mar sbyar ba las:

gzung 'dzin rtog tshogs dbyings su bsgral: 'khor gsum mtshan ma las 'das pa'i: mchog gi mchod pa chen po bzhes: sta na ga ṇa dzñā na pu dza ho: hrī: ngo bo chos sku snang mtha' yas: rang bzhin longs sku spyan ras gzigs: thugs rje sprul sku pad+ma 'byung : sku gsum dbyer med khyod la bstod: rig 'dzin bla ma kun gyi dngos: yi dam zhi khro'i 'khor los sgyur: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi rje: rtsa gsum kun 'dus khyod la bstod: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi: ye shes lus can de bzhin gshegs: mchog gsum ngo bo mtsho skyes rje: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas la bstod: de ltar mchod cing bstod pa'i mthus: gnas skabs rnam bzhi'i phrin las dang : mthar thug 'chi med sku gsum gyi: go 'phang tshe 'dir 'grub gyur cig: de nas dzab kyi dgongs pa ni: ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka ru: thabs shes nyi zla'i gwa'u'i dbus: ting 'dzin sems dpa'i hriḥdamar po: de mthar sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor: 'od kyis rtsa gsum lha tshogs mchod: byin rlabs dngos grub rang la thim: slar 'phros snod bcud dngos 'dzin sbyangs: lha sngags ye shes 'khor lor bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma dhe wa dhā ki nī sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ de ltar bsnyen dang sgrub pa'i sngags: rtse gcig 'bum phrag bcu gnyis bzlaḥ dngos sam nyams dang rmi lam du: dngos grub thob pa'i rtags rnams 'byung : sa ma ya: gsum pa las la sbyar ba ni: mchod cing bstod pa sngon 'gro bas: gdung ba'i dbyangs dang rol mor bcas: mi phyed dad pas thugs dam bskul: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ka dag dbyings kyi pho brang nas: ngo bo chos sku 'od mi 'gyur: mtsho skyes rdo rje'i thugs dam skul: gzung 'dzin zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: lhun grub rig pa'i pho brang nas: rang bzhin longs sku snying rje'i gter: thod phreng rigs lnga'i thugs dam skul:

ye shes rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: zung 'jug 'gro 'dul pho brang nas: thugs rje kun khyab sprul pa'i gar: mtshan mchog brgyad kyi thugs dam skul: rlung sems dbang 'dus phrin las mdzod: sku bzhi dbyer med pho brang nas: rtsa gsum kun 'dus he ru ka: pad+ma drag po'i thugs dam skul: gnyis 'dzin tshar gcod phrin las mdzod: gzugs snang rdo rje'i sku ru zlog: srog rtsol dbu ma'i phyag rgyar stims: rtog tshogs gdod nas rang grol bar: skye 'chi bral ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī sarba karma sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ lha tshogs kun gyi thugs ka nas: thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: thun mong mchog gi dngos grub dang : phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par bsam: sgrub pa'i sngags kyi sham bu ru: oṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: bhūm̐ puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ: hrīḥwā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭa: ces bzlas rlung sems dbyings la bskyal: rnam bzhi'i phrin las gang brtsam 'grub: sa ma ya: thun mtshams tshogs kyi mchod pa ni: thabs shes bza' btung dam tshig rdzas: gtsang zhing bkod pas mdzes par bsham: bdud rtsis bran la byin gyis brlab: hrīḥ bdag nyid thugs las 'od 'phros pas: tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin bsreg gtor sbyangs: phyi snod bde chen ka pā lar: nang bcud 'dod yon bdud rtsir gyur: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ de nas tshogs zhing spyan 'dren ni: hrī: 'og min bde chen zhing khams nas: chos sku 'od mi 'gyur ba la: bde gshegs rgya mtsho'i 'khor gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: lho phyogs ri po ta la nas: longs sku thugs rje chen po la: rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i 'khor gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: lho nub rnga yab dpal ri nas: sprul sku pad+ma thod phreng la: rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i 'khor gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:

gnas yul dur khrod brgyad rnams nas: ye shes mgon po ma ning nag: chos skyong rgya mtsho'i 'khor gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: tshogs khang rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing : tshogs rdzas zag med bdud rtsi'i bcud: snang grags rig pa lha dang sngags: ye shes chen por byin phob cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nā dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ tshogs phud rim pa gsum du spros: dang po 'dod yon rgya mtshos mchod: oṃ āḥhūm̐: snang ba snod kyi ka pā lar: srid pa bcud kyi tshogs gtor bshams: 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i mchod sprin 'dis: rtsa gsum lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: lhun grub phung po'i ka pā lar: rtsa rlung thig le'i tshogs gtor bshams: snang stong zung 'jug mchod sprin 'dis: rtsa gsum lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: 'od gsal dbu ma'i ka pā lar: srog rtsol kha sbyor tshogs gtor bshams: grags stong rang grol mchod sprin 'dis: rtsa gsum lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: lugs ldog thig le'i ka pā lar: dga' bzhi'i ye shes tshogs gtor bshams: bde stong dbyer med mchod sprin 'dis: rtsa gsum lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: gzhi dbyings gdod ma'i ka pā lar: gzhi snang ye shes tshogs gtor bshams: bla med mchog gi mchod sprin 'dis: rtsa gsum lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: yid bzhin 'dod 'byung ka pā lar: bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs gtor bshams: longs spyod rnam pa thams cad pas: rtsa gsum lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: 'chi med rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lhas: phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i: tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsa kra pū dza hoḥ bar pas dam tshig nyams chag bshags: hoḥ thog med dus nas da lta'i bar: las dang nyon mongs gzhan dbang gis: bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung kun:

tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: yi ge brgya pa brjod: tha ma bsgral zhing bstab pa ni: hūm̐: bdag tu lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs: bdag med rdo rje'i mtshon gyis bsgral: phung khams rigs lnga'i dam tshig rdzas: rtsa gsum lha tshogs zhal du sbyor: sarba shā' trūn bigh+nān mā ra ya ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza hoḥ de nas lus kyi dkyil 'khor lha: 'dod yon rdo rje'i dam tshig dang : snyoms 'jug byang sems bdud rtsis mchod: lhag gtor bsdus te byin gyis brlab: pheṃ pheṃ: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba yi: dbang phyug ging dang laṅka'i tshogs: dpal gyi pham phab 'di bzhes la: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ta ba liṃ ta bhuñdza ho:

srung mar sngon gyi tha tshig bsgrag: hūm̐ bh+yo: dbyings kyi thig le e ka dza: rig pa rang shar rā hu la: gnyis med ye shes ma ning nag: rgyud gsum dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas: sngon tshe kun bzang che ba'i mchog: pad+ma thod phreng spyan snga ru: ji ltar zhal bzhes dam bcas bzhin: 'dir gshegs dam rdzas gtor ma longs: rig 'dzin bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: dus min 'chi dang bar chad sol: tshe bsod dpal 'byor 'khor slob spel: rnam bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: shrī badz+ra dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta bhuñdza hoḥ bshal chus brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐: dus sbyor 'pho ba gnas dag pa'i: bden don yan lag bcu gnyis klong : ye shes grub kyang las kyi tshul: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma'i tshogs: a su ra yi brag phug tu: 'chi med pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: ji ltar bka' bsgos dam bzhag bzhin: tshur gshegs rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor du: he ru ka yi 'du bar spyon: bshal chu'i bdud rtsi 'di gsol la: gangs can 'gro kun bde ba dang : bstan pa dar ba'i phrin las mdzod: ma ma hrīng hrīng a mṛ ta pū dza ho: las mtha' rdo rje'i bro yis bsdu: hūm̐: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dam sri'i tshogs: rnam thar gsum ldan dbyings su mnan: rdo rje'i gar gyi rgyas btab pas: byang chub bar du+u ma ldangs shig: sarba shā trun bigh+nan s+t+wām+bha ya nan: de ltar brtson pa'i rnal 'byor par: bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing : mi mthun bar chad zhi ba dang : 'dod pa'i dngos grub myur thob 'gyur: sa ma ya: gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la: dang po dngos grub blang ba ni: oṃ āḥ hūm̐: byin rlabs gter chen dngos grub mdzod: phrin las char 'bebs lhag pa'i lha: rtsa gsum kun 'dus lha tshogs rnams: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag la: 'chi med tshe dang 'dzad med nor: nus pa sngags dang ting 'dzin sgo: las bzhi grub pa chen po brgyad:

rig 'dzin bzhi dang dbang bcu'i dpal: sku dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i: thun mong mchog gi dngos grub rnams: da lta nyid du stsal nas kyang : don gnyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma dhe wa dhā ki nī kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ gnyis pa nongs pa bshags pa ni: hoḥ don dam gzod nas spros bral la: gzung 'dzin mtshan ma las 'das phyir: kun rdzob glo bur 'khrul pa'i tshogs: 'khor gsum dmigs med dbyings su bshags: yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod: gsum pa nyer bsdu'i rnal 'byor ni: aḥ sems nyid skye ba med pa las: skye ba'i cho 'phrul dkyil 'khor lha: mkha' la 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar: 'od gsal gnyug ma'i klong du thim: a a aḥ bzhi pa chad mtha' bsal ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: slar yang cir snang lha yi sku: sgrar grags gzhom med rdo rje'i sgra: rtog tshogs rang grol rig pa'i dbyings: zung 'jug sgyu ma'i ngang nas spyod: lnga pa dge ba bsngo ba ni: hoḥ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can gyis: bsod nams ye shes dge ba'i tshogs: dus gsum bsags dang bsag 'gyur kun: byang chub snying por bsngo bar bgyi: drug pa smon lam gdab pa ni: deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du: bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral zhing*/ rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor gyis: rang gzhan don gnyis myur 'grub shog: bdun pa shis pa brjod pa ni: hoḥ phyogs dus rgyal ba sras bcas kyi: ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa'i dngos: rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma yis: byin gyis rlob pa'i bkra shis shog: chos sku'i ngang las longs spyod rdzogs: sprul pa'i rnam 'phrul cir yang shar: yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs kyis: dngos grub stsol ba'i bkra shis shog: gnas yul dur khrod zhing rnams su: tshar gcod rjes 'dzin bstan pa bsrung : dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis: bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i bkra shis shog: srid zhi'i phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas:

rgyal bstan phyogs bcur dar ba dang : bstan 'dzin skyes bu zhabs pad brtan: 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis shog: thun mong zhi rgyas dbang drag gi: phrin las gang brtsam myur 'grub cing : mthar thug mchog tu mi 'gyur dbyings: mngon par byang chub bkra shis shog: ces brjod me tog char du bsnyil: sa ma ya: de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis: rtsa gsum kun 'dus dkyil 'khor lha: bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i phrin las 'di: dad brtson ldan pas nyams blangs na: tshe 'dir mi mthun phyogs kun zhi: mchog thun dngos grub 'bad med 'byung : phyi ma rnga yab dpal gyi rir: 'chi med rig 'dzin nges par 'grub: rgya rgya rgya: dha thim:
